types.description: C60N miniature circuit breaker, 2 poles, 10 A, C curve; bare breaker

document.title: Protezione dei circuiti — Interruttori C60N, Curve B e C; reproduced in Schede tecniche dei materiali
document.revision: Underlying Schneider catalog revision unstated; municipal compilation dated December 2022
document.pages: Printed 14–15; physical PDF 5–6; exact 24268 row and diagram E45094 on PDF 6

modelingNotes: Manufacturer-authored catalog pages at a municipal mirror. Exact 24268 row establishes 2P, 10 A, curve C; diagram E45094 establishes terminal markings 1/2 and 3/4.

10 A rating at 30 degrees C; curve C magnetic operation 5–10 times In. Icn 6000 A at 400 V AC under CEI EN 60898. Icu 20 kA at 230–240 V AC or 10 kA at 400–415 V AC under CEI EN 60947-2. These conditions are not an assigned installation voltage or a universal interrupting rating.
Ui 500 V AC; Uimp 6 kV. At 10 A the cage terminals accept up to 16 mm² flexible or 25 mm² rigid conductor. These are documented capabilities, not conductor-sizing validation.

Diagram shows upper terminals 1 and 3 and lower terminals 2 and 4. No inferred phase/neutral aliases or enforced supply direction. Open contact state depicts the illustrated off position. Two poles are mechanically ganged, with no permanent conducting links.
Bare breaker only: separately ordered auxiliaries and residual-current accessories are not included. Trip dynamics, coordination and installation suitability are not modeled.

connectionCoverage.notes: All four power terminals in the exact selection table's 2P diagram E45094 are represented. No auxiliary, coil, PE, shield or communication terminals belong to the documented bare-breaker interface; accessory assemblies are excluded.
